Acceptance Criteria: Users can review products with their categories and prices, identify the highest-priced products and products within an inclusive price range, and view the full product list sorted by price or category. Ties are handled consistently, uncategorized products remain visible, and invalid price ranges are rejected.

Users can identify customers with the most orders, calculate each customer's total spending, find customers with no orders, rank customers by total spending, and rank product categories by spending for each customer. Customers without orders have zero spending, and tied values share ranks.

Users can review sales revenue by month and year, compare monthly and yearly sales, identify the top 10 products by units sold and the best-selling products within each category, and see each product's percentage contribution to revenue. Reporting periods are chronological, rankings handle ties consistently, and product revenue percentages use a consistent period total.

Users can identify products below their stock thresholds, compare each product's on-hand quantity across locations including zero-stock locations, review sales frequency, and prioritize restocking using stock shortfall and sales frequency.
